                                          ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-
Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 6-J in the area bounded by:
      A line 133.25 feet north of and parallel to West 26'*' Street; the public alley next east of and
      parallel to South Hamlin Avenue; a line 108.25 feet north of and parallel to West 26""
      Sfreet; and South Hamlin Avenue


to those of a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use Disfrict.
SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

12. Reason for rezoning the property:         to make the beauty parlor use conforming.



13. Describe the proposed use ofthe property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling
units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space; and height
of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC) The Property is improved with a two-story. 25 foot
tall building containing a beauty parlor on the ground floor and a residential unit on the second
floor, with a two car garage. The Applicant proposes to rezone the Property to bring the beauty
parlor use into conformance. The two parking spaces at the rear ofthe property will remain. No
changes will be made to the existing building.
